snippet.title: Holy Road - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
In Holy Road, you play the role of an exiled bishop. In order to reobtain what was rightfully yours, you must start all over from the very beginning. You must start your own kingdom, increase its population while defending your citizens, and thus increasing your wealth and power. Do you have what it takes to build your own kingdom from scratch?

On Steam:
http://bit.ly/2tk1QAN

Kagura Games on Steam:
http://bit.ly/2NDC6sD

Developer: Peperoncino
Publisher: Kagura Games
